Some are enormous while others are tiny; some move while others don’t; some live for years and others for just a few hours. It is equally clear that this diversity is not continuous but clustered. Organisms appear to fall into a discrete number of types or kinds, many of which can be recognized by young children. A 3-year-old can confidently judge that two animals in the park are both dogs, even if they are of different breeds; and a biologist will confirm that the child is correct—the animals do indeed belong to the same species, namely Canis familiaris. Thus it is natural to think that there are objective divisions between living organisms that it is the job of the biologist to discover. On this view, species boundaries are ‘out there’ in the world awaiting discovery, rather than being imposed on the world by biologists. Most non-biologists appear to accept this view without question.

这种常识性的观点与“自然种类”的哲学学说不谋而合，该学说的各种变体自亚里士多德以来就广为流传。这一学说认为，存在一些方法可以将物体归类为自然种类，这些种类之所以自然，是因为它们对应于世界上真实存在的划分，而不是反映人类的兴趣。化学元素和化合物就是典型的自然种类。例如，考虑宇宙中所有纯金的样本。这些样本都属于“金”这一种类，因为它们在一个根本方面是相同的：构成它们的原子原子序数均为79。相比之下，黄铁矿（愚人金）的样本虽然在某些方面与金相似，但它并不属于这一种类，因为它是由不同种类的原子（铁和硫）组成的化合物。信奉科学实在论的哲学家通常认为，任何科学的部分任务就是在其领域内发现自然种类。

This commonsense viewpoint dovetails with the philosophical doctrine of ‘natural kinds’, variants of which have been popular since Aristotle. This doctrine holds that there are ways of grouping objects into kinds that are natural in the sense of corresponding to divisions that really exist in the world, rather than reflecting human interests. Chemical elements and compounds are paradigm natural kinds. Consider for example all the samples of pure gold in the universe. These samples are of the kind ‘gold’ because they are alike in a fundamental respect: their constituent atoms have atomic number 79. By contrast, a sample of fool’s gold (iron pyrite) does not belong in that kind, despite being similar to gold in some respects, for it is a compound formed by atoms of a different sort (iron and sulphur). Philosophers who embrace scientific realism often argue that part of the job of any science is to discover the natural kinds in its domain.

物种是生物学自然分类的观点固然吸引人，但也面临诸多挑战。其中之一是，物种的界定可能存在一定的任意性。为了理解这一点，我们不妨看看生物学家如何将物种细分为品种、变种和亚种等类别。例如，金雕（Aquila chrysaetos）通常被分为六个亚种，包括欧洲金雕、美洲金雕和日本金雕。引入亚种分类的动机在于，某些种群之间存在明显的差异，但差异又不足以被视为不同的物种。然而，我们该如何划定清晰的界限呢？达尔文在《物种起源》中对此进行了有趣的探讨，他认为物种、亚种和变种之间并不存在明确的界限。他总结道：“可以看出，我把‘物种’这个术语看作是为了方便而随意赋予一组彼此非常相似的个体的术语，它与‘变种’这个术语本质上并没有区别，‘变种’指的是不太明显且变化更大的形态。”

The idea that species are the natural kinds of biology is an attractive one, but faces a number of challenges. One is that there may be an element of arbitrariness in what counts as a species. To see why, note that biologists often subdivide species into groupings such as breeds, varieties, and sub-species. For example the golden eagle Aquila chrysaetos is usually divided into six sub-species, which include the European, American, and Japanese golden eagle. The motivation for introducing sub-specific groupings is that some populations are recognizably different from each other, but not so different as to count as separate species. But how do we draw a sharp line? Darwin offers an interesting discussion of this point in The Origin of Species, arguing that no clear demarcation exists between species, sub-species, and varieties. He concluded: ‘it will be seen that I look at the term species as one arbitrarily given, for the sake of convenience, to a set of individuals closely resembling each other, and that it does not essentially differ from the term variety, which is given to less distinct and more fluctuating forms.’

达尔文认为一组个体是否构成一个物种是任意的，这令人惊讶；这显然与物种作为自然种类的概念不符。但达尔文的观点正确吗？在20世纪，许多进化生物学家确信，物种实际上是自然界中的真实单元，而非任意的分组，理由是它们之间存在生殖隔离。这意味着同一物种内的个体可以相互交配，但不能与其他物种的个体交配。德国生物学家恩斯特·迈尔倡导用生殖隔离来定义生物物种，这一概念被称为“生物物种概念”（BSC）。BSC的支持者驳斥了达尔文关于变种/物种区分是任意的论点。在他们看来，欧洲金雕和美洲金雕是变种，而非不同的物种，因为它们原则上可以交配并产生可育后代（即使这种情况很少发生）。相比之下，斑雕和金雕是不同的物种，因为它们的成员不能交配。

Darwin’s suggestion that whether a set of individuals counts as a species is arbitrary is surprising; certainly it does not fit with the idea of species as natural kinds. But is Darwin right? In the 20th century, many evolutionary biologists became convinced that species are in fact real units in nature, not arbitrary groupings, on the grounds that they are reproductively isolated. This means that the organisms within a species can interbreed with each other but not with those of other species. Defining biological species in terms of reproductive isolation was championed by the German biologist Ernst Mayr, and became known as the ‘biological species concept’ (BSC). Proponents of the BSC reject Darwin’s argument that the variety/species distinction is arbitrary. On their view, the European and American golden eagles are varieties, not separate species, since they can in principle interbreed and produce viable offspring (even if they do so rarely). By contrast, the spotted eagle and the golden eagle are separate species, since their members cannot interbreed.

生物物种隔离理论（BSC）在现代生物学中被广泛应用，但它也存在局限性。该理论仅适用于有性生殖生物；然而，许多生物进行无性生殖，包括大多数单细胞生物、一些植物和真菌以及少数动物。因此，BSC充其量只能部分解决物种问题。此外，生殖隔离并非总是绝对的。生活在相邻区域的近缘物种常常在其分布范围交汇处形成“杂交带”；在这些区域，会发生一定程度的杂交，至少在某些情况下会产生可育后代，但两个物种仍然保持各自的独立性。杂交带通常出现在一个物种分裂成两个物种的过程中。尤其是在植物中，属于明显不同物种的个体之间的杂交现象十分普遍。

The BSC is widely used in contemporary biology, but it has limitations. It only applies to sexually reproducing organisms; however, many living organisms reproduce asexually, including most single-celled organisms, some plants and fungi, and a few animals. So the BSC is at best a partial solution to the species problem. Moreover, reproductive isolation is not always a hard and fast matter. Closely related species who live in adjacent locations often have ‘hybrid zones’ where their ranges meet; in these zones, a limited amount of hybridization takes place, in which fertile offspring are produced at least some of the time, but the two species retain their distinct identities. Hybrid zones often arise when one species is in the process of splitting into two. Among plants, in particular, hybridization between organisms that belong to clearly distinct species is quite common.

对于生物安全中心（BSC）而言，更棘手的问题是环状物种现象。当一个物种由若干个在地理上呈环状分布的局部种群组成时，就会出现这种情况；每个种群都可以与其相邻的种群杂交，但位于环状分布链末端的种群则不能。例如，假设种群 A 可以与 B 杂交，B 可以与 C 杂交，C 可以与 D 杂交，D 可以与 E 杂交，但 A 和 E 不能杂交（见图8）。环状物种对生物安全中心来说构成了一种悖论。为了理解这一点，不妨问问自己 A 和 E 是否属于同一物种。由于它们不能杂交，答案应该是“否”。然而，根据杂交标准，A 和 B 是同种的，B 和 C、C 和 D 以及 D 和 E 也是如此，那么 A 和 E 肯定也是同种的吧？在生物安全中心，对于这种情况，我们很难给出明确的解释。因此，达尔文坚持认为，物种的认定存在任意性，而对生殖隔离的关注并不能完全消除这种任意性。

Still more problematic for the BSC is the phenomenon of ring species. This occurs when a species comprises a number of local populations arranged geographically in a ring; each population can interbreed with an immediate neighbour, but the populations at the end of the chain cannot. For example, suppose population A can interbreed with B, B with C, C with D, D with E, but A and E cannot interbreed (see Figure 8). Ring species constitute a kind of paradox for the BSC. To see why, ask yourself whether A and E belong to the same species or not. Since they cannot interbreed, the answer should be ‘no’. However A and B are con-specific by the interbreeding criterion, as are B and C, C and D, and D and E, so surely A and E must be con-specific? It is quite unclear what to say about this situation, on the BSC. So Darwin’s insistence that there is an element of arbitrariness in what gets counted as a species is not entirely defused by the focus on reproductive isolation.

8.环状物种。双箭头表示杂交。

8. Ring species. A double-headed arrow indicates interbreeding.

物种问题的根本原因在于进化本身。现代生物学遵循达尔文的理论告诉我们，所有生物都起源于共同的祖先。然而，传统的林奈分类学却源于神创论盛行的时代。主流世界观。在创造论的观点中，上帝分别创造了每个物种，因此人们自然会认为所有生物都可以被明确地归类到不同的物种。但在进化论的观点中，这种预期是不成立的。因为进化是一个渐进的过程——一个祖先物种演化成一个子物种的过程通常需要数千年。它常常涉及一个物种逐渐分裂成两个，最终两个子物种之间的生殖联系断裂。因此，过渡形态以及物种地位不明的种群的存在是必然的。此外，也没有理由认为单一的物种定义能够适用于所有生物，从细菌到多细胞动物。

The underlying source of the species problem is evolution itself. Modern biology teaches us, following Darwin, that all living organisms derive from a common ancestor. However traditional Linnean taxonomy derives from a time when creationism was the dominant worldview. On a creationist view, in which God created each species separately, it is natural to expect that all organisms can be assigned to species unambiguously. But on an evolutionary view there is no reason to expect this. For evolutionary change is gradual—the process by which an ancestral species gives rise to a daughter species typically takes many thousands of years. Often it involves one species gradually splitting into two, with reproductive links between the two daughter species eventually being severed. So transitional forms, and populations whose status as species is unclear, are only to be expected. Moreover, there is no reason to expect that a single species definition will work for all organisms, from bacteria to multi-celled animals.

进化论也告诉我们，生物体之间的变异很可能普遍存在。因为变异是自然选择的驱动力：如果一个物种内的生物体没有变异，自然选择就无法发挥作用。这意义重大，因为它动摇了人们的常识性观念，即生物物种的成员必须都具备某些本质特征，例如某些遗传属性，才能将它们与其他物种区分开来。这种观念是物种“自然类”观的一部分，也是许多非生物学家似乎认同的观点。然而，经验表明，生物体之间存在广泛的遗传变异。典型物种内部的个体差异有时甚至超过近缘物种之间的遗传变异。这并非否认生物学家通常可以通过DNA测序来确定生物体所属的物种。然而，这并非总是可行，也并不意味着物种归属是由固定的“遗传本质”决定的。

Evolution also teaches us that variation among organisms is likely to be pervasive. For variation is the engine that drives natural selection: if the organisms in a species do not vary then natural selection cannot operate. The significance of this is that it undermines the commonsense idea that the members of a biological species must all possess some essential feature, e.g. some genetic property, which sets them apart from non-members. This idea is part of the ‘natural kind’ view of species, and is something that many non-biologists appear to believe. Empirically, however, there is extensive genetic variation among the individuals within a typical species, which sometimes exceeds the genetic variation between closely related species. This is not to deny that biologists can often tell what species an organism belongs to by sequencing its DNA. However this is not always possible, and it does not show that membership of a species is determined by a fixed ‘genetic essence’.

因此，进化极大地增加了分类学的复杂性。然而，分类学工作必须继续进行，因为将生物体划分为物种实际上是不可或缺的。例如，如果一位鸟类学家遇到一只不寻常的鸟，他们首先想知道的就是它属于哪个物种，因为这能提供关于其特征、行为和生态的重要信息。英国生物学家约翰·梅纳德·史密斯曾精辟地描述过这种情况，他写道：“任何试图将所有生物体，无论古今，划分成界限分明、彼此之间不存在中间状态的类群的尝试，都注定会失败。分类学家面临着一项任务在实践上的必要性和理论上的不可能性之间的矛盾。” 因此，在实践中，生物学家仍然像对待界限分明的类群一样对待物种，尽管他们也知道这只是对现实的一种近似。

Evolution therefore complicates the taxonomic enterprise considerably. However the enterprise must go on, for dividing organisms into species is practically indispensable. If an ornithologist comes across an unusual bird, for example, the first thing they will want to know is what species it is from, as this provides valuable information about its traits, behaviour, and ecology. The situation was eloquently described by the English biologist John Maynard Smith, who wrote: ‘any attempt to divide all living organisms, past and present, into sharply defined groups between which no intermediates exist, is foredoomed to failure. The taxonomist is faced with a contradiction between the practical necessity and the theoretical impossibility of his task.’ So in practice biologists continue to treat species as if they were sharply defined kinds, in the knowledge that this is only an approximation to reality.

自20世纪60年代末以来，进化生物学日益倾向于认为分类应该与进化“一致”。这正是由德国昆虫学家威利·亨尼格创立的“系统发育系统学”运动的核心思想。其核心理念是，只有单系群才被认为是真正的生物类群，这意味着它们包含且仅包含某个共同祖先的所有后代。许多传统的分类群，例如爬行纲（爬行动物），已被证明并非单系群——在这种情况下，因为所有爬行动物的祖先也演化出了鸟类（见图9）。因此，系统发育分类的支持者坚持认为，爬行纲并非真正的分类单元，在正确的分类体系中不应占有一席之地。系统学主要关注如何界定更高级别的分类单元，而非物种。然而，单系性标准可以应用于单个物种，由此产生所谓的“系统发育物种概念”；实际上，这一概念旨在精确地阐述一个直观的想法，即同一物种内的个体之间的亲缘关系应该比与其他物种的成员之间的亲缘关系更近。

From the late 1960s onwards, evolutionary biology has increasingly converged on the idea that classification should be done in a way that is ‘consistent’ with evolution. This was the leitmotif of the movement known as ‘phylogenetic systematics’, founded by the German entomologist Willi Hennig. The key idea was to recognize as genuine only those biological groupings that are monophyletic, which means that they contain all and only the descendants of some common ancestor. Many traditional taxonomic groupings, e.g. the class Reptilia (the reptiles), have turned out not to be monophyletic—in this case, because the ancestor of all the reptiles also gave rise to the birds (see Figure 9). So proponents of phylogenetic classification insist that Reptilia is not a genuine taxon, and has no place in a correct taxonomy. Phylogenetic systematics is mainly concerned with how to delimit higher taxa, rather than species. However the monophyly criterion can be applied to individual species, yielding what is known as the ‘phylogenetic species concept’; in effect, this concept is an attempt to formulate precisely the intuitive idea that the organisms within a species should be more closely related to each another than to the members of other species.

9.蜥蜴、鳄鱼和鸟类之间的系统发育关系。

9. Phylogenetic relationship between lizards, crocodiles, and birds.

从哲学角度来看，系统发育方法的意义在于，它表明两个生物体之所以属于同一类群——物种或更高级别的分类单元——是因为它们拥有共同的祖先，而非它们内在的相似性。一个思想实验可以帮助我们更好地理解这一点。假设科学家在火星上发现了一种生物体，它并非源自地球生物物质，但却与常见的家蝇完全无法区分。（当然，这种情况发生的概率极低，但从逻辑上讲是可以设想的。）这个火星样本看起来像家蝇，可以与地球上的家蝇杂交，并且任何基因检测都无法将其与真正的家蝇区分开来。那么，它算是家蝇吗？如果物种是自然界的种类，那么答案很可能是肯定的。但从系统发育的角度来看，答案是否定的。要被认定为家蝇（Musca domestica）物种，一个生物体需要具备相应的祖先模式，而与其内在特征无关。

From a philosophical viewpoint, the significance of the phylogenetic approach is its implication that two organisms belong to the same group—species or higher taxon—because of their shared ancestry, rather than their intrinsic similarity. A thought experiment can help flesh this out. Suppose that scientists find an organism on Mars that is not derived from earthly biological matter, but nonetheless is completely indistinguishable from a common housefly. (This is incredibly unlikely, of course, but it is logically conceivable.) The Martian specimen looks like a housefly, can interbreed with houseflies back on earth, and cannot be told apart from true houseflies by any genetic tests. Is it a housefly? If species were natural kinds, the answer would presumably be yes. But on a phylogenetic view, the answer is no. To be of the housefly species (Musca domestica), an organism needs to have the appropriate pattern of ancestry, irrespective of what intrinsic features it has.

这与生物学家迈克尔·吉塞林和哲学家大卫·赫尔在20世纪70年代提出的一个有趣的观点不谋而合。他们认为，生物物种根本不应该被视为一种类型或类别（这是传统的假设），而应该被视为一个独立的个体。物种如同一个在时空维度上延伸的复杂个体。如同单个生物体，物种诞生于特定的时空，拥有有限的寿命，最终走向灭绝。与之相反，真正的“类”在时空上是不受限制的。以黄金为例。宇宙中任何物质，无论其来源如何，只要原子序数为79，都可被视为黄金。因此，理论上，宇宙中所有的黄金都可以被摧毁，多年以后又可以合成新的黄金。但吉塞林和赫尔认为，物种并非如此。一旦一个物种灭绝，从逻辑上讲，它就永远不可能再次出现，就像你我死后无法复活一样。

This tallies with an intriguing suggestion made by the biologist Michael Ghiselin and the philosopher David Hull in the 1970s. They argued that a biological species should not be regarded as a kind or type at all, which is the traditional assumption, but rather as a complex individual extended in space and time. Like an individual organism, a species comes into existence at a particular place and time, has a finite lifespan, and then goes extinct. By contrast, a genuine kind is spatiotemporally unrestricted. Consider gold. A piece of matter anywhere in the universe counts as gold, irrespective of its origin, so long as it has atomic number 79. So in principle, all the gold in the universe could be destroyed and then years later some more could be synthesized. But species are not like this, Ghiselin and Hull argued. Once a species goes extinct it can never come back into existence as a matter of logic, any more than you or I can survive our deaths.

物种是独立个体的观点乍听之下或许有些奇怪，但仔细思考后便会发现其中的道理。诚然，物种与“普通”个体不同，因为它们的组成部分，即它们所包含的生物体，并非彼此相连。然而，这种区别相当表面化。蚁群中的昆虫也并非彼此相连，但我们仍然乐于将蚁群视为一个独立的个体。将物种视为独立个体具有显著的优势。首先，它与系统发育学的原则高度契合。其次，它有助于调和以下两点：一方面，人们普遍认为物种是自然界中“真实”的单元，而非任意的分类；另一方面，种内遗传变异普遍存在，物种并不具有“遗传本质”。如果我们把物种视为复杂的个体，这些事实便能得到合理的解释；但如果我们把它们视为自然种类，这些事实就显得难以理解了。

The idea that species are individuals sounds strange at first but makes sense on reflection. Certainly, species are unlike ‘ordinary’ individuals in that their constituent parts, i.e. the organisms they contain, are not joined together. However this difference is fairly superficial. The insects in an ant colony are not joined together either, but we are happy to regard the colony as an individual thing. Treating species as individuals has distinct advantages. One is that it fits well with the principles of phylogenetic systematics. Another is that it helps reconcile the widespread intuition that species are ‘real’ units in nature, not arbitrary groupings, with the fact that intra-specific genetic variation is widespread and that species do not have ‘genetic essences’. These facts make good sense if we view species as complex individuals, but make much less sense if we regard them as natural kinds.

思维是模块化的吗？

Is the mind modular?

人类能够完成各种各样的认知任务，而且通常无需太多意识努力，这是一个令人惊叹的事实。我们所说的“认知任务”不仅指解填字游戏之类的事情，还包括安全过马路、接球、理解他人说话、识别他人面孔等日常任务。这些任务对我们来说如此熟悉，以至于我们很容易习以为常；然而，我们完成这些任务的能力却远非我们想象的那般简单。完成这些任务确实令人惊叹。尽管造价不菲，但没有任何机器人能够像普通人那样出色地完成大多数此类任务。我们的大脑以某种方式使我们能够以最小的努力完成复杂的认知任务。解释这种现象是认知心理学这一学科的重要组成部分。

It is a striking fact that humans are able to perform a diverse array of cognitive tasks, often with fairly little conscious effort. By ‘cognitive tasks’ we do not just mean things like solving crossword puzzles, but also everyday tasks like crossing the road safely, catching a ball, understanding what other people say, recognizing other people’s faces, and more. Such tasks are so familiar to us that they are easily taken for granted; however our ability to perform them is really quite remarkable. No robot comes close to being able to perform most of these tasks as well as an average human, despite considerable expense. Somehow or other, our brains enable us to perform complex cognitive tasks with minimal effort. Explaining how this could be is an important part of the discipline known as cognitive psychology.

我们关注的是认知心理学家之间关于人类心智结构的持续争论。一种观点认为，人类心智是一个“通用问题解决者”。这意味着心智包含一套通用的问题解决技能，或称“通用智能”，并将其应用于数量无限多的不同任务。因此，无论一个人是在数弹珠、决定去哪家餐厅吃饭，还是学习一门外语，所使用的都是同一套认知能力——这些任务代表了人类通用智能的不同应用。另一种观点则认为，人类心智包含许多专门的子系统或模块，每个子系统或模块都旨在执行特定的任务，而不能执行其他任何任务。这被称为心智模块化假说。

Our focus is an ongoing debate among cognitive psychologists concerning the architecture of the human mind. According to one view, the human mind is a ‘general-purpose problem solver’. This means that the mind contains a set of general problem-solving skills, or ‘general intelligence’, which it applies to an indefinitely large number of different tasks. So one and the same set of cognitive capacities are employed, whether a person is trying to count marbles, decide which restaurant to eat in, or learn a foreign language—these tasks represent different applications of the person’s general intelligence. According to a rival view, the human mind contains a number of specialized sub-systems or modules, each of which is designed for performing a specific task and cannot do anything else. This is known as the modularity of mind hypothesis.

语言学专家诺姆·乔姆斯基在20世纪60年代关于语言习得的研究中，就体现了模块化的一个例子。乔姆斯基坚持认为，儿童并非通过偷听成人对话，然后运用其“一般智力”来推断所讲语言的规则而习得语言。他认为，这是不可能的，因为儿童接触到的语言数据非常有限，而且因人而异；然而，所有儿童习得语言的年龄却大致相同。乔姆斯基提出，每个儿童的大脑中都存在一个被称为“语言习得装置”的独特模块。该装置自动运行，其唯一功能是帮助儿童习得语言。它通过编码所有人类语言都遵循的“普遍语法”原则来实现这一点，使儿童在适当的提示下能够学习任何语言的语法。乔姆斯基还提出了一个……一系列令人印象深刻的证据支持语言习得是一种模块化能力的说法——例如，即使是“一般智力”较低的人通常也能学会说一口流利的英语。

One example of modularity comes from the work of the linguist Noam Chomsky on language acquisition in the 1960s. Chomsky insisted that a child does not learn language by overhearing adult conversation and then using their ‘general intelligence’ to figure out the rules of the language being spoken. This is impossible, he argued, for the linguistic data that children are exposed to are too limited, and vary greatly from child to child; yet all children acquire language by the same age. Chomsky argued that there is a distinct module called the ‘language acquisition device’ in every child’s brain. The device operates automatically, and its sole function is to enable the child to acquire language. It does this by encoding the principles of ‘universal grammar’ that all human languages obey, enabling the child to learn the grammar of any language given appropriate prompting. Chomsky provided an array of impressive evidence for the claim that language acquisition is a modular capacity—such as the fact that even those with low ‘general intelligence’ can usually learn to speak perfectly well.

支持模块化假说的最有力证据之一来自对脑损伤患者的研究，即所谓的“缺陷研究”。如果人类大脑是一个通用问题解决系统，我们预期大脑损伤会对所有认知能力产生大致相同的影响。但事实并非如此。相反，脑损伤通常会损害某些认知能力，而对其他能力则不受影响。例如，大脑中被称为韦尼克区的损伤会导致患者无法理解语言，但他们仍然能够流畅地表达语法正确的句子。这有力地表明，句子生成和理解是两个独立的模块——因为这可以解释为什么理解能力的丧失不会导致句子生成能力的丧失。其他脑损伤患者会丧失长期记忆（失忆症），但他们的短期记忆以及说话和理解能力却不受影响。这似乎再次支持了模块化假说，并反驳了大脑是一个通用问题解决系统的观点。

Some of the most compelling evidence for the modularity hypothesis comes from studies of patients with brain damage, known as ‘deficit studies’. If the human mind is a general-purpose problem solver, we would expect damage to the brain to affect all cognitive capacities more or less equally. But this is not what we find. On the contrary, brain damage often impairs some cognitive capacities but leaves others untouched. For example, damage to a part of the brain known as Wernicke’s area leaves patients unable to understand speech, though they are still able to produce fluent, grammatical sentences. This strongly suggests that there are separate modules for sentence production and comprehension—for this would explain why loss of the latter capacity does not entail loss of the former. Other brain-damaged patients lose their long-term memory (amnesia), but their short-term memory and ability to speak and understand are unimpaired. Again, this seems to speak in favour of modularity and against the view of the mind as a general-purpose problem solver.

尽管这类神经心理学证据令人信服，但它们并不能彻底解决模块化问题。此类证据相对稀少——我们显然不能随意损伤人的大脑，仅仅为了观察其认知能力会受到怎样的影响。此外，正如科学界常见的现象，对于如何解读这些数据也存在分歧。一些人认为，在脑损伤患者中观察到的认知障碍模式并不意味着大脑具有模块化。他们认为，即使大脑是一个通用问题解决系统，即非模块化的，不同的认知能力仍然可能受到脑损伤的不同程度的影响。因此，我们不能简单地从缺陷研究中推断出大脑的结构；充其量，后者只能为前者提供不可靠的证据。

Though compelling, neuropsychological evidence of this sort does not settle the modularity issue decisively. Such evidence is relatively sparse—we obviously cannot damage people’s brains at will just to see how their cognitive capacities are affected. In addition, there are disagreements about how the data should be interpreted, as is usual in science. Some argue that the observed pattern of cognitive impairment in brain-damaged patients does not imply modularity. Even if the mind were a general-purpose problem solver, i.e. non-modular, it is still possible that distinct cognitive capacities might be differentially affected by brain damage, they argue. So we cannot simply read off the architecture of the mind from deficit studies; at best, the latter provide fallible evidence for the former.

近年来人们对模块化的浓厚兴趣很大程度上归功于美国哲学家兼心理学家杰里·福多（Jerry Fodor）的研究。在1983年出版的《心智的模块化》（The Modularity of Mind）一书中，福多对模块的概念提出了新颖的解释，并就哪些认知能力是模块化的、哪些不是提出了一些有趣的观点。福多认为，心理模块具有一些显著特征，其中三个尤为重要：（i）它们具有领域特异性；（ii）它们的运作是强制性的；（iii）它们在信息上是封装的。非模块化系统则缺乏这些特征。福多进一步指出，心智部分地是模块化的，但并非完全如此：我们利用专门的模块来解决一些认知任务，而利用我们的一般智能来解决另一些任务。

Much of the recent interest in modularity is due to the work of Jerry Fodor, an American philosopher and psychologist. In a 1983 book entitled The Modularity of Mind Fodor offered a novel account of what a module is, and some interesting ideas about which cognitive capacities are modular and which not. Fodor argued that mental modules have a number of distinguishing features, of which three are particularly important: (i) they are domain-specific, (ii) their operation is mandatory, and (iii) they are informationally encapsulated. Non-modular systems lack these features. Fodor then argued that the mind is partly though not wholly modular: we solve some cognitive tasks using specialized modules, others using our general intelligence.

认知系统具有领域特异性，意味着它具有专门性：它执行一组有限的、精确界定的任务。乔姆斯基提出的语言习得机制就是一个例子。该机制的唯一功能是帮助儿童学习语言——它不会帮助儿童学习下棋、计数或其他任何技能。因此，该机制会忽略非语言输入。认知系统具有强制性，意味着我们无法选择是否启用它。语言感知就是一个例子。如果你听到一句用你熟悉的语言说出的句子，你必然会将其听作一个完整的句子。如果有人要求你把这句话听作“纯粹的噪音”，无论你多么努力，你都无法做到。福多指出，并非所有认知过程都具有这种强制性。清晰思考就不是。如果有人让你想想你一生中最可怕的时刻，或者想想如果你中了彩票你会做什么，你显然可以按照他们的指示去做。因此，思维和语言感知在这方面截然不同。

To say that a cognitive system is domain-specific is to say that it is specialized: it performs a limited, precisely circumscribed set of tasks. Chomsky’s postulated language acquisition device is an example. The sole function of this device is to enable the child to learn language—it doesn’t help the child learn to play chess, or to count, or anything else. So the device ignores non-linguistic inputs. To say that a cognitive system is mandatory is to say that we cannot choose whether to put it into operation. The perception of language is an example. If you hear a sentence uttered in a language you know, you cannot help but hear it as the utterance of a sentence. If someone asked you to hear the sentence as ‘pure noise’ you couldn’t obey them however hard you tried. Fodor points out that not all cognitive processes are mandatory in this way. Thinking clearly is not. If someone asked you to think of the scariest moment in your life, or of what you would do if you won the lottery, you clearly could obey their instructions. So thinking and language perception are quite different in this regard.

那么信息封装呢？这个概念最好用一个例子来说明。请看图 10中的两条平行线。对大多数人来说，上面的线看起来比下面的线略长。但实际上，这是一种视觉错觉，称为缪勒-莱尔错觉。这两条线的长度实际上是相等的。

What about informational encapsulation? This notion is best illustrated by an example. Look at the two parallel lines in Figure 10. To most people, the top line looks slightly longer than the bottom one. But in fact this is an optical illusion, known as the Müller-Lyer illusion. The lines are actually equal in length.

10.缪勒-莱尔错觉。

10. The Müller-Lyer illusion.

关于为什么上面的线条看起来更长，人们提出了各种各样的解释，但我们在此不必赘述。关键在于：即使你知道这是一种视觉错觉，两条线看起来仍然不等长。福多尔认为，这个简单的事实对于理解大脑的结构具有重要意义。因为它表明，两条线长度相等的信息存储在认知大脑的一个区域，而我们的感知机制无法访问该区域。如果视觉感知并非如此封闭，而是可以利用大脑中存储的所有信息，那么一旦你被告知两条线实际上长度相等，这种错觉就会立即消失。

Various explanations have been suggested for why the top line looks longer, but they need not concern us here. The point is this: the lines continue to look unequal in length even when you know it’s an optical illusion. According to Fodor, this simple fact has important implications for understanding the architecture of the mind. For it shows that the information that the two lines are equal in length is stored in a region of the cognitive mind to which our perceptual mechanisms do not have access. If visual perception was not encapsulated in this way, but could make use of all the information stored in the mind, then the illusion would disappear as soon as you were told that the lines were actually equal in length.

信息封装的另一个可能例子来自人类的恐惧症现象。以恐蛇症为例，这种恐惧症在人群中十分普遍。即使你知道某条蛇并不危险，例如，有人告诉你它的毒腺已被切除，你仍然很可能害怕它，并且不想去碰它。这种恐惧症通常可以通过训练克服，但这又是另一个话题了。关键在于，当你看到蛇时，大脑中负责产生恐惧反应的那部分无法获取“蛇不危险”这一信息。这表明，每个人体内可能都存在一个内置的、信息封装的“恐蛇症”模块。

Another possible example of information encapsulation comes from the phenomenon of human phobias. Consider ophidiophobia, or fear of snakes, which is widespread among humans. Even if you know that a particular snake isn’t dangerous, e.g. because you’ve been told that its poison glands have been removed, you are still quite likely to be scared of it and will not want to touch it. This sort of phobia can often be overcome by training, but that is a different matter. The key point is that the information that the snake isn’t dangerous is inaccessible to the part of your mind which produces in you the reaction of fear when you see a snake. This suggests that there may be an inbuilt, informationally encapsulated ‘fear of snakes’ module in every human being.

你或许会疑惑，为什么心智的模块化问题会成为哲学家们的话题。这难道不是一个科学事实的问题吗？心智是否具有模块化结构？某种程度上来说，这种说法没错，但这场争论涉及诸多哲学层面。其中之一便是如何计算认知任务和模块的数量。模块化理论的支持者认为，心智包含用于执行不同认知任务的专门模块；而反对者则否认这一点。

You may wonder why the modularity of mind issue is a matter for philosophers. Surely it is just a question of scientific fact whether the mind is modular or not? In a way this is true, but the debate has a number of philosophical dimensions. One concerns how to count cognitive tasks and modules. Advocates of modularity hold that the mind contains specialized modules for performing different cognitive tasks; their opponents deny this.

但是，我们如何判断两个认知任务是相同还是不同呢？面部识别是一个单一的认知任务，还是包含两个不同的认知任务：识别男性面孔和识别女性面孔？长除法和长乘法是不同的认知任务，还是它们都属于更一般的算术运算任务？这类问题属于概念性或哲学性问题，而非直接的经验性问题，它们对模块化之争至关重要。假设模块化理论的反对者提出实验证据，证明我们使用单一的认知能力来执行多种不同类型的认知任务。反对者可能会接受实验数据，但会辩称这些认知任务本质上是同一类型的，因此这些数据完全符合模块化理论。所以，为了明确模块化之争的本质，我们需要一种系统性的方法来统计认知任务和模块。

But how do we decide whether two cognitive tasks are the same or different? Is facial recognition a single cognitive task or does it comprise two distinct cognitive tasks: recognizing male faces and recognizing female faces? Are long division and multiplication different cognitive tasks, or are they both part of the more general task of doing arithmetic? Questions of this sort are conceptual or philosophical, rather than straightforwardly empirical, and are potentially crucial to the modularity debate. For suppose an opponent of modularity produces experimental evidence to show that we use a single cognitive capacity to perform many different types of cognitive task. Their opponent might accept the experimental data, but argue that the cognitive tasks in questions are all of the same type, and thus that the data are perfectly compatible with modularity. So in order for the modularity debate to be well defined, a principled way of counting cognitive tasks and modules is needed.

第二个哲学维度源于模块化理论的支持者和反对者都运用了先验论证以及直接的经验证据来支持各自的观点。福多本人认为，感知和语言或许是模块化的，但思维和推理却不是，因为它们是“整体性的”。为了理解福多的论证，假设你是一名陪审员，正在商议如何做出判决。你会如何进行这项任务？你会考虑的一点是被告的陈述是否逻辑一致——是否存在矛盾？你还会问自己，针对被告的证据究竟有多强。你在这里运用的推理技能——检验逻辑一致性和评估证据——是通用的；它们并非专门为特定案件而设计的。在陪审团服务中，你运用认知能力来判断被告是否有罪，这种认知能力并非特定领域专属，也并非强制性的——你必须有意识地思考被告是否有罪，并且可以随时停止思考，例如在午休时间。此外，也不存在信息封装。你的任务是综合考虑所有因素来判断被告是否有罪，因此，如果你认为某个背景信息与案件相关，你可能需要利用这些信息。例如，如果被告在交叉询问中出现紧张的抽搐，而你认为​​这种紧张的抽搐通常是犯罪的迹象，那么你很可能会在做出裁决时运用这种信念。因此，不存在任何你用来做出裁决的认知机制无法获取的信息（尽管法官可能会要求你忽略某些信息）。简而言之，并不存在一个专门用于判断被告是否有罪的模块。你运用的是你的一般智力来解决这个认知问题。

A second philosophical dimension arises because both proponents and opponents of modularity have employed a priori arguments, in addition to direct empirical evidence, in support of their view. Fodor himself argued that while perception and language are probably modular, thinking and reasoning cannot be since they are ‘holistic’. To understand Fodor’s argument, suppose you are a member of a jury deliberating over what verdict to return. How will you go about your task? One thing you will consider is whether the defendant’s story is logically consistent—is it free from contradiction? And you will ask yourself how strong the evidence against the defendant really is. The reasoning skills you apply here—testing for logical consistency and assessing evidence—are general; they are not specifically designed for use in jury service. So the cognitive capacities you bring to bear in deliberating the defendant’s guilt are not domain-specific. Nor is their operation mandatory—you have to consciously consider whether the defendant is guilty, and can stop doing so whenever you want to, e.g. during the lunch break. Finally, there is no information encapsulation either. Your task is to decide whether the defendant is guilty all things considered, so you may have to draw on any of the background information that you possess, if you consider it relevant. For example, if the defendant twitched nervously under cross-examination and you believe that nervous twitching is often a sign of guilt, you will probably draw on this belief in reaching your verdict. So there is no store of information which is inaccessible to the cognitive mechanisms you employ to reach your verdict (though the judge may tell you to ignore certain things). In short, there is no module for deciding whether a defendant is guilty. You tackle this cognitive problem using your general intelligence.

一些心理学家比福多尔走得更远，提出人类心智完全是模块化的；这被称为“大规模模块化假说”。大规模模块化假说的支持者认为，我们应该预期人类心智会呈现出模块化的组织结构。他们的主要论点源于达尔文的适应性进化论。人们普遍认为，人类心智是在更新世时期进化而来的，目的是为了让我们的原始人类祖先能够应对当时面临的社会和环境挑战。他们认为，模块化的组织结构是解决这些挑战并实现适应性行为的最有效方式。一组专门的模块，每个模块都针对特定任务进行专门设计，可以更快、更准确地解决问题。瑞士军刀的比喻在这里很贴切。显然，拥有分别用于开罐头、开瓶盖和拧螺丝的工具，比拥有一个可以完成所有这些任务的万能工具要好得多。同样，拥有分别用于面部识别、语言习得和择偶等功能的独立模块的心智，会比一个通用型的心智更高效。求解器。因此，从最优设计的角度来看，思维模块化是有利的，论点是这样的。

Some psychologists have gone further than Fodor and suggested that the mind is entirely modular; this is known as the ‘massive modularity hypothesis’. Proponents of massive modularity argue on general grounds that we should expect the human mind to exhibit a modular organization. Their main argument comes from considerations of Darwinian adaptiveness. The human mind is widely supposed to have evolved in the Pleistocene epoch, to allow our hominid ancestors to solve the social and environmental challenges they faced. The suggestion is that a modular organization provides the most efficient way of solving these challenges and so behaving adaptively. A set of dedicated modules, each specialized for a given task, allows faster and more accurate problem solving. The Swiss army knife analogy is relevant here. Clearly, having separate tools for can-opening, bottle-opening, and screw-driving is preferable to having a single all-purpose tool that can do each of these things. Similarly, a mind with separate modules for face recognition, language acquisition, and mate choice, for example, will be more efficient than one that is a general-purpose problem solver. So considerations of optimal design tell in favour of mental modularity, the argument goes.

一个相关的论点认为，人类不可能在一生中获取所有适应环境所需的信息。学习的机会实在太少。因此，大脑需要包含一些先天信息，这些信息被封装在一个模块中，使儿童能够发展出相应的认知技能，从而实现适应性行为。乔姆斯基的语言习得模块就说明了这一点。该模块包含了关于每种人类语言语法的先天信息，使儿童能够在极少的输入下习得一门语言。解决认知任务所需的信息与可通过学习获得的信息之间的这种“差距”经常被用来支持模块化的认知组织。然而，严格来说，这实际上是在论证大脑包含先天信息，而不是支持模块化本身。这些概念在逻辑上是不同的，但在实践中，模块化的支持者往往相信先天信息的存在，反之亦然。

A related argument holds that a human cannot possibly acquire all the information needed to behave adaptively in its own lifetime. The opportunities for learning are simply too few, it is argued. Therefore the mind needs to contain innate information, encapsulated in a module, which will allow the child to develop the appropriate cognitive skills and thus behave adaptively. Chomsky’s language acquisition module illustrates this point. The module contains innate information about the grammar of every human language, enabling the child to acquire a language given quite minimal input. This ‘gap’ between the information needed to solve a cognitive task and the information that can be acquired by learning is often used to argue in favour of a modular cognitive organization. Strictly speaking, though, it is an argument for the mind’s containing innate information, rather than for modularity per se. These are logically distinct ideas, but in practice defenders of modularity tend to believe in innate information and vice versa.

模块性和先天性之间的这种联系揭示了模块性辩论在哲学上具有重要意义的另一个方面。认为心灵包含先天信息的观点与传统的经验主义哲学截然相反，后者认为所有知识都来源于经验。在17和18世纪，约翰·洛克和大卫·休谟等经验主义者认为，人类出生时心灵就像一张“白板”，上面什么都没有。只有通过经验，人类才能获得概念和知识。这种经验主义学说由来已久，乍一看似乎显而易见。但乔姆斯基认为，他的语言习得模块包含了关于普遍语法的先天信息，这直接反驳了经验主义哲学的这一方面。如果乔姆斯基的论证是正确的——这是一个备受争议的观点——那么它提供了一个有趣的例子，说明科学发现如何能够为传统的哲学辩论提供信息。

This connection between modularity and innateness points to another respect in which the modularity debate is philosophically significant. The idea that the mind contains innate information is sharply at odds with traditional empiricist philosophy, according to which all knowledge comes from experience. In the 17th and 18th centuries, empiricists such as John Locke and David Hume argued that at birth the human mind is a ‘tabula rasa’, or blank slate, with nothing written on it. It is only through experience that a human comes to have concepts and knowledge. This empiricist doctrine is a venerable one, and at first sight strikes many as obviously true. But Chomsky argued that his language acquisition module, containing as it does innate information about universal grammar, directly disproves this aspect of the empiricist philosophy. If Chomsky’s argument is correct—a hotly debated point—it provides an interesting example of how scientific findings can inform traditional philosophical debates.

现在断言大规模模块化理论是否站得住脚还为时尚早。先验的论证（正反双方的论证）本身并不能解决问题；需要直接证据。福多本人就否定大规模模块化理论，因此他对认知心理学能否解释人类思维的运作机制持悲观态度。他认为只有模块化系统才能进行科学研究——非模块化系统由于信息封装性差，建模难度更大。因此，福多认为认知心理学家的最佳研究策略是专注于感知和语言，而忽略思维和推理。但不出所料，福多的这一观点极具争议。

It is too early to say whether the massive modularity thesis will prove tenable. The a priori arguments (for and against) cannot themselves settle the issue; direct evidence is needed. Fodor himself rejects massive modularity, and as a result is pessimistic about the possibility of cognitive psychology ever explaining the workings of the human mind. He believes that only modular systems can be studied scientifically—non-modular systems, because they are not informationally encapsulated, are much more difficult to model. So according to Fodor the best research strategy for cognitive psychologists is to focus on perception and language, leaving aside thinking and reasoning. But unsurprisingly, this aspect of Fodor’s thought is highly controversial.

第七章

Chapter 7

科学及其批评者

Science and its critics

许多人理所当然地认为科学是一件好事，原因显而易见。毕竟，科学为我们带来了电力、安全的饮用水、青霉素和航空旅行——所有这些都无疑造福了人类。然而，尽管科学对人类福祉做出了如此令人瞩目的贡献，它也并非没有批评者。有人认为社会在科学上投入过多资金，而忽视了艺术；也有人指出，科学赋予了我们一些我们本可以避免的技术能力，例如大规模杀伤性武器。一些女权主义者认为科学本质上带有男性偏见；有宗教信仰的人常常觉得科学威胁到了他们的信仰；而人类学家则指责西方科学傲慢地认为自己凌驾于土著文化的知识和信仰之上。以上并非科学所遭受的全部批评，但在此，我们将重点关注其中三个具有特殊哲学意义的批评。

Many people take it for granted that science is a good thing, for obvious reasons. After all, science has given us electricity, safe drinking water, penicillin, and air travel—all of which have undoubtedly benefited humanity. But despite these impressive contributions to human welfare, science is not without its critics. Some argue that society spends too much money on science at the expense of the arts; others observe that science has given us technological capabilities we would be better off without, e.g. weapons of mass destruction. Some feminists argue that science is inherently male-biased; those of religious persuasion often feel that science threatens their faith; and anthropologists have accused Western science of arrogantly assuming its superiority over the knowledge and beliefs of indigenous cultures. This does not exhaust the list of criticisms to which science has been subject, but here we confine our attention to three that are of particular philosophical interest.

科学主义

Scientism

“科学”一词在现代社会获得了一种特殊的象征意义。如果有人指责你的行为不科学，他们几乎肯定是在批评你。科学的行为是理性的、值得称赞的；不科学的行为是非理性的、应受鄙视的。我们很难理解为什么人们会把某些事情称为科学的。“科学家”一词或许带有这些含义，但这可能与科学在现代社会中享有的崇高地位有关。科学家被视为专家，人们经常就重要的社会问题征求他们的意见。当然，人人都知道科学家有时也会犯错；例如，20世纪90年代初，英国政府的科学顾问宣称“疯牛病”对人类没有威胁，但后来却被证明犯下了悲剧性的错误。然而，这类偶尔出现的失误并不会动摇公众对科学的信任，也不会影响人们对科学家的尊重。在许多国家，科学家的地位很像过去的宗教领袖：他们拥有普通民众无法企及的专业知识。

The word ‘scientific’ has acquired a peculiar cachet in modern times. If someone accuses you of behaving unscientifically, they are almost certainly criticizing you. Scientific conduct is rational and praiseworthy; unscientific conduct is irrational and worthy of contempt. It is difficult to know why calling something scientific should carry these connotations, but it probably relates to the high status which science holds in modern society. Scientists are treated as experts, their opinions regularly sought on matters of social importance. Of course, everybody recognizes that scientists sometimes get it wrong; for example, scientific advisers to the British government in the early 1990s declared that ‘mad cow’ disease posed no threat to humans, only to be proved tragically mistaken. But occasional hiccups of this sort tend not to shake the public faith in science, nor the esteem in which scientists are held. In many countries, scientists are viewed much as religious leaders used to be: possessors of specialized knowledge that is inaccessible to the laity.

“科学主义”是某些哲学家用来贬义地描述他们眼中的科学崇拜，或者说是对现代科学过度崇敬的态度。科学主义的反对者认为，科学并非唯一有效的智力活动形式，也并非理解世界的唯一途径。他们经常强调，他们并非反对科学本身；他们反对的是科学方法必然适用于所有学科的假设。因此，他们的目标并非攻击科学，而是通过否定科学知识就是全部知识的观点来对其进行反思。

‘Scientism’ is a pejorative term used by some philosophers to describe what they see as science worship, or an over-reverential attitude towards modern science. Opponents of scientism argue that science is not the only valid form of intellectual endeavour, and not the only way of understanding the world. They often stress that they are not anti-science per se; what they are opposed to is the assumption that scientific methods are necessarily applicable to every subject matter. So their aim is not to attack science but to put it in place, by rejecting the idea that scientific knowledge is all the knowledge there is.

科学主义是一个相当模糊的理论，而且由于这个词带有贬义，很少有人会公开承认自己信奉它。然而，类似崇拜科学的现象在知识界却是真实存在的。这未必是件坏事——或许科学确实值得被崇拜。但这无疑是一种真实存在的现象。当代英语哲学（科学哲学只是其中的一个分支）经常被指责存在科学崇拜。尽管哲学与数学和科学有着密切的历史联系，但传统上它被视为人文学科，这并非没有道理。因为哲学探讨的问题，例如知识的本质、道德以及人类福祉等，似乎与数学和科学无关。这些问题无法用科学方法解决。没有任何科学分支能够告诉我们应该如何生活、什么是知识，或者人类的繁荣包含哪些要素；这些本质上都是哲学问题。

Scientism is a rather vague doctrine, and, given that the term has a pejorative usage, few would explicitly admit to believing it. Nonetheless, something quite like science worship is a genuine feature of the intellectual landscape. This is not necessarily a bad thing—perhaps science deserves to be worshipped. But it is certainly a real phenomenon. One field which is often accused of science worship is contemporary anglophone philosophy (of which philosophy of science is just one branch). Traditionally philosophy is regarded as a humanities subject, despite its close historical links to mathematics and science, and with good reason. For philosophy asks questions about the nature of knowledge, morality, and human well-being, for example, which do not seem soluble by scientific methods. No branch of science tells us how we should lead our lives, what knowledge is, or what human flourishing involves; these are quintessentially philosophical questions.

鉴于此，一些哲学家坚持认为科学是通往知识的唯一合法途径，这或许令人惊讶。他们认为，无法通过科学手段解决的问题根本就不是真正的问题。20世纪英国著名哲学家伯特兰·罗素也赞同这一观点，他写道：“凡是可获得的知识，都必须通过科学方法获得；科学无法发现的，人类也无法知晓。”这一观点的依据在于一种名为“自然主义”的学说，它强调我们人类是自然世界不可分割的一部分，而不是像过去人们认为的那样，与自然世界分离。既然科学研究的是整个自然世界，那么它理应能够揭示关于人类生存状态的全部真相，哲学也就无从下手了。按照这种观点，哲学本身并没有独特的研究对象。如果说哲学有什么作用的话，那就是“澄清科学概念”——扫清障碍，以便科学家们能够继续他们的工作。

In the light of this, it may seem surprising that some philosophers insist that science is the only legitimate path to knowledge. Questions that cannot be resolved by scientific means are not genuine questions at all, they hold. This view was endorsed by the famous 20th-century English philosopher Bertrand Russell, who wrote: ‘whatever knowledge is attainable, must be attained by scientific methods; and what science cannot discover, mankind cannot know’. The grounds for the view lie in a doctrine called ‘naturalism’, which stresses that we human beings are part and parcel of the natural world, not something apart from it, as was once believed. Since science studies the whole of the natural world, surely it should be capable of revealing the complete truth about the human condition, leaving nothing left for philosophy? On this view, philosophy has no distinctive subject matter of its own. Insofar as it serves a useful role at all, it involves ‘clarifying scientific concepts’—clearing the brush so that scientists can get on with their work.

不出所料，许多哲学家反对哲学从属于科学；这正是他们反对科学主义的原因之一。他们认为，哲学探究拥有其独特的方法，能够揭示科学无法揭示的真理。持这种观点的人认为，哲学应当力求与科学保持一致，也就是说，哲学不应提出与科学教导相冲突的主张。他们通常也承认，人类是自然秩序的一部分，因此不能凌驾于科学的范畴之上。但他们指出，这并不意味着科学是了解世界的唯一合法途径。

Not surprisingly, many philosophers reject this subordination of their discipline to science; this is one source of opposition to scientism. They argue that philosophical enquiry has its own proprietary methods, which can reveal truths of a sort that science cannot. Proponents of this view allow that philosophy should aim to be consistent with the sciences, in the sense of not advancing claims which conflict with what science teaches us. And they typically accept that we humans are part of the natural order, so not exempt from the scope of science. But it does not follow, they argue, that science is the only legitimate source of knowledge about the world.

这些哲学探究方法究竟是什么？它们包括逻辑推理、思想实验以及所谓“概念分析”，是指通过依赖我们对特定案例是否属于某个概念的直觉来界定该概念。例如，一个经典的哲学问题是：知识是否等同于真信念？大多数哲学家认为答案是否定的，理由是我们可以构建这样一些案例：一个人确实相信某个命题，但却不能说他真正了解它。（例如，假设你相信现在是六点十分，因为你的手表显示的时间是六点十分；事实上你的手表坏了，但碰巧时间确实是六点十分！因此，你的信念是正确的，但直觉上你并不知道现在是六点十分，你只是“运气好”。）所以，通过概念分析，我们可以确定知识和真信念并非同一概念——这是一个实质性的哲学真理。这只是一个例子；但它说明了哲学探究如何运用其自身的非科学方法获得真正的知识。

What exactly are these methods of philosophical enquiry? They include logical reasoning, the use of thought experiments, and what is called ‘conceptual analysis’, which tries to delimit a particular concept by relying on our intuitions about whether a particular case falls under it. For example, a classical philosophical question asks whether knowledge is identical to true belief. Most philosophers say that the answer is ‘no’, on the grounds that we can construct cases in which a person does truly believe a particular proposition but cannot be said to know it. (For example, suppose you believe that it is ten past six because that is what your watch says; in fact your watch is broken, but by chance the time is actually ten past six! Your belief is therefore true, but intuitively you did not know that it was ten past six as you simply ‘got lucky’.) So by using conceptual analysis, we can establish that knowledge and true belief are not identical—which is a substantive philosophical truth. This is just one example; but it illustrates the idea that philosophical enquiry can yield genuine knowledge using its own non-scientific methods.

这场辩论该如何评价？一方面，的确存在一些哲学问题，它们看似真切，超越了任何科学的范畴，并且能够用哲学家独特的方法来解答。然而，另一方面，哲学史上讨论过的许多问题，例如关于感知、想象和记忆的问题，最终都归属于经验科学，尤其是心理学的范畴。事实上，几个世纪以来，被归类为“哲学”的问题范围一直在缩小，因为越来越多的问题被科学所涵盖。此外，认为哲学探究和科学探究是相互独立的，各自依赖自身方法的观点，也被批评为一厢情愿的想法；反对者指出，尽管科学领域无疑取得了进步，但哲学领域的进步却难以察觉。

How should this debate be assessed? On the one hand, there are certainly examples of philosophical questions which appear to be genuine, to lie outside the provenance of any science, and to be answerable by the distinctive methods of philosophers. However, against this, many of the questions discussed in the history of philosophy, e.g. about perception, imagination, and memory, have turned out to be matters for the empirical sciences, in particular psychology. Indeed the pool of questions classed as ‘philosophical’ has shrunk over the centuries, as more and more get appropriated by science. Moreover, the idea that philosophical enquiry and scientific enquiry are autonomous, each relying on their own methods, has been criticized as wishful thinking; opponents point out that while there is certainly progress in science, progress in philosophy is rather harder to discern.

一个类似的问题涉及自然科学和社会科学之间的关系。正如哲学家抱怨其学科中存在“科学崇拜”一样，社会科学家也抱怨其学科中存在“自然科学崇拜”。人们常常认为，自然科学，例如……物理学、化学和生物学的发展水平高于经济学、社会学和人类学等社会科学；前者能够构建具有强大预测能力的精确定律，而后者通常无法做到这一点。这是为什么呢？这不太可能是因为自然科学家比社会科学家更聪明。一个可能的解释是，自然科学的方法更胜一筹。如果这是正确的，那么社会科学要想迎头赶上，就必须效仿自然科学的方法。在某种程度上，这种情况已经发生。社会科学中数学的日益普及可能部分源于这种态度。当伽利略将数学语言应用于运动描述时，物理学取得了巨大的进步；因此，人们很容易认为，如果社会科学也能找到类似的“数学化”方法，那么它或许也能取得类似的飞跃。

An analogous issue concerns the relation between the natural and social sciences. Just as philosophers complain of ‘science worship’ in their discipline, so social scientists complain of ‘natural science worship’ in theirs. It is often felt that natural sciences such as physics, chemistry, and biology are in a more advanced state than social sciences such as economics, sociology, and anthropology; the former can formulate precise laws with great predictive power, while the latter usually cannot. Why should this be so? It can hardly be because natural scientists are smarter than social scientists. One possible answer is that the methods of the natural sciences are superior. If this is correct, then what the social sciences need to do to catch up is to ape the methods of the natural sciences. To some extent this has already happened. The increasing use of mathematics in the social sciences may be partly a result of this attitude. Physics made a great leap forward when Galileo took the step of applying mathematical language to the description of motion; so it is tempting to think that a comparable leap forward might be achievable in the social sciences if a comparable way of ‘mathematicizing’ their subject matter can be found.

然而，一些社会科学家反对以这种方式仰望自然科学，他们认为自然科学的方法未必适用于研究社会现象。他们通常否认社会科学相对于自然科学而言存在不足，并指出社会现象的复杂性以及通常无法进行受控实验的事实，意味着找到具有预测能力的精确规律并非衡量成功的合适标准。

However, some social scientists resist the suggestion that they should look up to the natural sciences in this way, arguing that the methods of natural science are not necessarily appropriate for studying social phenomena. They typically deny that the social sciences are impoverished vis-à-vis the natural sciences, pointing out that the complexity of social phenomena, and the fact that controlled experiments usually cannot be done, mean that finding precise laws with predictive power is not an appropriate benchmark of success.

这一论点的颇具影响力的版本源于19世纪德国社会学家威廉·狄尔泰和马克斯·韦伯。他们认为，必须从行为者的视角来理解社会现象。社会现象与自然现象的区别在于，前者是人类有意行为的结果。因此，社会科学研究需要一种特殊的理解方式，称为“理解” （verstehen ）；这涉及试图把握社会行为对行为者而言的主观意义。例如，研究宗教仪式的民族学家需要理解该仪式对参与者的意义；纯粹的“客观”分析，例如运用自然科学方法进行的分析，无法真正理解仪式，因为它忽略了仪式意义这一关键问题。因此，理解（verstehen ）理论确立了自然科学和社会科学之间的显著差异。该理论对人类学和社会学的发展产生了深远的影响，尤其是在20世纪。

An influential version of this argument derives from the 19th-century German sociologists Wilhelm Dilthey and Max Weber. They argued that social phenomena must be understood from the viewpoint of the actor(s) responsible for them. What distinguishes social from natural phenomena is that the former are the result of the intentional action of humans. Thus a special type of understanding, called verstehen, is needed for social scientific enquiry; this involves trying to grasp the subjective meaning that a social action has for the actor. For example, an anthropologist studying a religious ritual needs to understand the significance that the ritual has for the participants; a purely ‘objective’ analysis, of the sort that could be had by applying the methods of natural science, cannot yield a genuine understanding of the ritual, since it neglects the crucial matter of the ritual’s meaning. The doctrine of verstehen thus posits a sharp discontinuity between the natural and social sciences. The doctrine had a significant influence on the development of anthropology and sociology, in particular, in the 20th century.

科学主义问题以及与之相关的自然科学与社会科学之争都不容易解决。部分原因是，我们并不完全清楚“科学方法”或“自然科学方法”究竟包含哪些内容——这一点在辩论双方中常常被忽略。如果我们想知道科学方法是否适用于所有学科，或者是否能够回答所有重要问题，显然我们需要了解这些方法究竟是什么。但正如我们所见，这个问题远比表面看起来复杂。我们当然知道科学探究的一些主要特征：实验检验、观察、理论构建和归纳推理。但这一系列特征并不能提供“科学方法”的精确定义。而且，这样的定义是否能够给出也并非显而易见。科学随着时间的推移而快速发展，因此，认为存在一种固定不变的“科学方法”，并被所有科学学科在任何时候都使用，这种假设并非必然成立。但这种假设既隐含在“科学是通往知识的唯一途径”这一论断中，也隐含在“有些问题无法用科学方法解答”这一反驳论断中。这表明，至少在某种程度上，关于科学主义的争论可能建立在一个错误的假设之上。

Neither the scientism issue nor the parallel issue about natural and social science is easy to resolve. In part, this is because it is not fully clear what exactly the ‘methods of science’, or the ‘methods of natural science’, actually comprise—a point that is often overlooked by both sides in the debate. If we want to know whether the methods of science are applicable to every subject matter, or whether they are capable of answering every important question, we obviously need to know what exactly those methods are. But as we have seen, this is less straightforward a question than it seems. Certainly we know some of the main features of scientific enquiry: experimental testing, observation, theory construction, and inductive inference. But this list does not provide a precise definition of ‘the scientific method’. Nor is it obvious that such a definition could be provided. Science changes rapidly over time, so the assumption that there is a fixed, unchanging ‘scientific method’, used by all scientific disciplines at all times, is not inevitable. But this assumption is implicit both in the claim that science is the only route to knowledge and in the counter-claim that some questions cannot be answered by scientific methods. This suggests that, to some extent at least, the debate about scientism may rest on a false presupposition.

科学与宗教

Science and religion

科学与宗教之间的紧张关系由来已久。或许最著名的例子就是伽利略与天主教会的冲突。1633年，宗教裁判所强迫伽利略公开放弃他的哥白尼观点，并判处他在佛罗伦萨软禁多年。教会反对哥白尼的理论，当然是因为它违背了圣经。近年来，最引人注目的科学与宗教冲突莫过于美国达尔文主义者和“智能设计论”支持者之间的激烈争论，这也是本文的重点。

The tension between science and religion is old. Perhaps the best-known example is Galileo’s clash with the Catholic Church. In 1633 the Inquisition forced Galileo to publicly recant his Copernican views and condemned him to spend his last years under house arrest in Florence. The Church objected to the Copernican theory because it contravened the holy Scriptures, of course. In recent years, the most prominent science/religion clash has been the bitter dispute between Darwinists and proponents of ‘intelligent design’ in the United States, which will be our focus here.

神学界对达尔文进化论的反对由来已久。 1859年《物种起源》出版后，立即遭到英国教会人士的批评。原因显而易见：达尔文的理论认为，包括人类在内的所有现存物种，都是在漫长的岁月中由共同祖先演化而来。这一理论显然与《创世记》相悖，《创世记》记载上帝在六天内创造了所有生物。一些达尔文主义者试图调和他们对进化论的信仰与基督教信仰，他们认为《创世记》不应按字面意思解读，而应视为寓言或象征性的。然而，在美国，许多福音派新教徒不愿为了迎合科学发现而改变他们的宗教信仰。他们坚持认为圣经中关于创世的记载是字面意义上的真实，因此达尔文的进化论完全错误。

Theological opposition to Darwin’s theory of evolution is nothing new. When The Origin of Species was published in 1859, it immediately attracted criticism from churchmen in England. The reason is obvious: Darwin’s theory maintains that all current species, including humans, have descended from common ancestors over a long period of time. This theory clearly contradicts the Book of Genesis, which says that God created all living creatures over a period of six days. Some Darwinians have tried to reconcile their belief in evolution with their Christian faith by arguing that the Book of Genesis should not be interpreted literally—it should be regarded as allegorical, or symbolic. However, in the USA, many evangelical Protestants have been unwilling to bend their religious beliefs to fit scientific findings. They insist that the biblical account of creation is literally true, and that Darwin’s theory of evolution is therefore completely wrong.

这种观点被称为“神创论”，在美国约有40%的成年人接受它。神创论是一股强大的政治力量，多年来对美国高中生物教学产生了相当大的影响，这令科学家们感到沮丧。由于美国宪法禁止在公立学校教授宗教，于是“神创论科学”应运而生——它声称圣经中的创世记述比达尔文的进化论更能科学地解释地球上的生命。因此，教授圣经创世论并不违反宪法禁令，因为它属于科学范畴，而非宗教！1981年，阿肯色州通过了一项法律，要求生物教师必须向学生讲授圣经创世论。进化论和神创论应享有“同等时间”。然而，这一裁决在第二年被一位联邦法官推翻，1987年，最高法院裁定在公立学校教授神创论违宪。

This opinion is known as ‘creationism’, and is accepted by some 40 per cent of the adult population in the USA. Creationism is a powerful political force, and over the years has had considerable influence on the teaching of biology in American high schools, to the dismay of scientists. Since the American constitution prohibits the teaching of religion in public schools, ‘creation science’ was invented—which claims that the biblical account of creation is a better scientific explanation of life on earth than Darwin’s theory of evolution. So teaching biblical creation does not violate the constitutional ban, for it counts as science, not religion! In 1981 a law was passed in Arkansas calling for biology teachers to give ‘equal time’ to evolution and creation science. However this was overruled by a federal judge the following year, and in 1987 a Supreme Court judgment ruled that teaching creation science in public schools was unconstitutional.

在这些法律诉讼失败后，创造科学运动巧妙地将自己重新包装成“智能设计”的代名词。这个名称暗指一种古老的上帝存在论证，即“设计论证”。该论证认为，复杂生物体的存在只能通过假设它们是由一位智慧的神创造的来解释；这位神通常被认为是基督教的上帝。设计论证在达尔文时代之前曾是主流思想的一部分，但当然已被当代生物学家所否定。智能设计的支持者重新拾起了这一论证，声称生物体展现出“不可简化的复杂性”，这种复杂性不可能通过达尔文的进化方式产生，因此证明了上帝的创造。一个“不可简化的复杂”系统指的是一个由多个相互作用的组成部分构成的系统，每个组成部分对于系统的正常运作都至关重要——移除或改变其中任何一个部分，系统都会崩溃。生物有机体，乃至单个细胞，从这个意义上讲确实很复杂，因为它们的功能依赖于许多生化成分的协调活动。智能设计论者认为，这种相互依存关系不可能通过自然选择进化而来。

Following these legal defeats, the creation science movement cleverly rebranded itself under the label ‘intelligent design’. The name is an allusion to an old argument for the existence of God, known as the ‘argument from design’, which says that the existence of complex biological organisms can only be explained by supposing that an intelligent deity created them; this deity is usually identified with the Christian God. The argument from design was part of the intellectual mainstream in the pre-Darwinian era, but is of course rejected by contemporary biologists. Proponents of intelligent design have resuscitated the argument, claiming that biological organisms exhibit ‘irreducible complexity’ which could not have evolved by Darwinian means, and is thus proof of God’s handiwork. An ‘irreducibly complex’ system is one with a number of interacting parts each of which is critical to the system’s functioning—remove or alter any one of the parts and the system breaks down. It is true that biological organisms, and indeed individual cells, are complex in this sense, as their functioning depends on the coordinated activity of many biochemical components. This sort of interdependence could not have evolved by natural selection, claim the intelligent design camp.

尽管这种论点最近备受关注，但它不过是旧瓶装新酒。在《物种起源》中，达尔文本人也曾思考过脊椎动物的眼睛这种高度复杂的器官是如何通过自然选择进化而来的，他指出，乍一看这似乎“荒谬”。然而，达尔文认为，可以通过想象一个演化过程来解决这个难题：从简单的眼睛（或许只有几个感光细胞）到现代眼睛，眼睛经历了一系列渐进式的改进，每一次改进都赋予了眼睛一定的选择优势。这样一来，一个结构极其复杂、精细的器官，通过自然选择进化而来，便能解释这一难题。眼睛的某些组成部分可能通过自然选择进化而来。达尔文本人也只能猜测眼睛进化的中间阶段。但近期的科学研究通过对脊椎动物胚胎发育的研究以及详细的基因分析，对眼睛进化的可能阶段顺序提供了详尽的见解。因此，眼睛不可能通过自然选择产生的观点已被成功驳斥。由此可见，没有任何证据支持生物体所展现的任何特征不可能是进化过程的结果。

Despite its recent prominence, this argument is old wine in new bottles. In The Origin of Species, Darwin himself wondered how the vertebrate eye, a highly complex organ, might have evolved by natural selection, noting that at first blush it seems ‘absurd’. However, Darwin believed that the difficulty could be resolved by imagining a sequence leading from a simple eye (perhaps just a few light-sensitive cells) to modern eyes by a gradual series of incremental improvements, each of which conferred a selective advantage. In this way an organ of great complexity, with finely tuned components, could have evolved by natural selection. Darwin himself could only guess as to what the intermediate stages of eye evolution were. But recent scientific work has offered detailed insight into the probable sequence of stages, based on studying the embryonic development of the eye, and performing detailed genetic analyses, across vertebrate species. So the suggestion that the eye could not have arisen by natural selection has been successfully rebutted. The moral generalizes: there is no evidence to support the idea that organisms exhibit any features that could not have resulted from an evolutionary process.

除了强调“不可简化的复杂性”之外，智能设计论的支持者还试图从其他方面削弱达尔文的世界观。他们认为达尔文主义的证据尚不充分，因此不应将其视为既定事实，而应将其视为“仅仅是一种理论”。此外，他们还关注达尔文主义者内部的各种争论，并抓住个别生物学家的不当言论大做文章，试图证明反对进化论在科学上是合理的。他们最终得出结论：既然达尔文主义“仅仅是一种理论”，那么学生也应该接触其他理论，例如所有生物都是由一位智慧的神创造的理论。

In addition to their emphasis on ‘irreducible complexity’, proponents of intelligent design have tried to undermine the Darwinian worldview in other ways. They argue that the evidence for Darwinism is inconclusive, so Darwinism should not be regarded as established fact but rather as ‘just a theory’. In addition, they have focused on various internal disputes among Darwinians, and picked on a few incautious remarks by individual biologists, in an attempt to show that disagreeing with the theory of evolution is scientifically respectable. They conclude that since Darwinism is ‘just a theory’, students should be exposed to alternative theories too—such as the theory that an intelligent deity created all living organisms.

从某种意义上说，达尔文主义“仅仅是一种理论”而非已被证实的“事实”是完全正确的。正如我们在第二章中看到的，从严格意义上讲，我们永远无法证明一个科学理论是正确的，因为从数据推导出理论的过程总是非演绎性的。但这只是一般性的观点——它与进化论本身无关。同样地，我们也可以说地球绕太阳转、水是由H₂O组成的、以及物体在无支撑状态下会下落都“仅仅是一种理论” ，因此应该向学生展示这些理论的替代方案。但智能设计论的支持者并没有这样论证。他们并非对整个科学持怀疑态度，而是对进化论本身持怀疑态度。因此，如果他们的立场要站得住脚，那么……不能仅仅因为我们的数据不能保证达尔文理论的正确性就断定结论正确。因为同样的道理也适用于所有科学理论，实际上也适用于大多数常识性信念。

In a way, it is quite correct that Darwinism is ‘just a theory’ and not proven fact. As we saw in Chapter 2, it is never possible to prove that a scientific theory is true, in the strict sense of proof, for the inference from data to theory is invariably non-deductive. But this is a general point—it has nothing to do with the theory of evolution per se. By the same token, we could argue that it is ‘just a theory’ that the earth goes round the sun, or that water is made of H2O, or that unsupported objects tend to fall, so students should be presented with alternatives to each of these. But proponents of intelligent design do not argue this. They are not sceptical about science as a whole, but about the theory of evolution in particular. So if their position is to be defensible, it cannot simply turn on the point that our data doesn’t guarantee the truth of Darwin’s theory. For the same is true of every scientific theory, and indeed of most commonsense beliefs too.

另一种智能设计论的论点是，化石记录并不完整，尤其是在智人祖先的化石方面。这种说法不无道理。进化论者长期以来一直对化石记录中的空白感到困惑。一个长期存在的难题是，为什么“过渡化石”（即介于两个物种之间的过渡生物化石）如此稀少。如果像达尔文的理论所言，后来的物种是由早期物种进化而来，那么过渡化石理应很常见才对。然而，这并不能成为反对达尔文理论的有力论据。因为化石并非进化论的唯一证据来源，甚至并非主要证据来源。其他证据来源包括比较解剖学、胚胎学、生物地理学和遗传学。例如，人类和黑猩猩拥有98%的相同DNA。如果进化论是正确的，那么这一事实以及成千上万个类似的现象就完全说得通，因此构成了支持进化论的有力证据。当然，智能设计论的支持者也可以解释这一事实，认为设计者出于自身的原因选择使人类和黑猩猩在基因上相似。但这种“解释”的可能性恰恰表明，达尔文的理论并非由现有证据逻辑推导而来，因此原则上可以编造出其他解释。这种方法论上的论点是正确的，但这并不能说明达尔文主义有何特殊之处。

Another intelligent design argument is that the fossil record is patchy, particularly when it comes to the supposed ancestors of Homo sapiens. There is some truth in this charge. Evolutionists have long puzzled over the gaps in the fossil record. One persistent puzzle is why there are so few ‘transition fossils’—of creatures intermediate between two species. If later species evolved from earlier ones as Darwin’s theory asserts, surely transition fossils should be common? However this is not a good argument against Darwin’s theory. For fossils are not the only or even the main source of evidence for the theory of evolution. Other sources include comparative anatomy, embryology, biogeography, and genetics. Consider for example the fact that humans and chimpanzees share 98 per cent of their DNA. This and thousands of similar facts make perfect sense if the theory of evolution is true, and thus constitute excellent evidence for the theory. Of course, a proponent of intelligent design can also explain this fact, by saying that the designer chose to make humans and chimpanzees genetically similar for reasons of his (or her) own. But the possibility of giving ‘explanations’ of this sort simply shows that Darwin’s theory is not logically entailed by the evidence, so in principle other explanations can be concocted. This methodological point is correct, but shows nothing special about Darwinism.

尽管智能设计论阵营的论点完全站不住脚，但这场争议确实引发了关于科学教育的严肃问题。在世俗教育体系中，应该如何处理科学与信仰之间的冲突？谁应该决定高中科学课程的内容？如果家长不希望自己的孩子学习进化论或其他科学知识，国家是否应该凌驾于他们的意愿之上？这些问题通常很少引起公众的关注。但达尔文主义与智能设计之间的冲突使它们走到了聚光灯下。

Though the arguments of the intelligent design camp are uniformly unsound, the controversy does raise serious questions concerning science education. How should the tension between science and faith be dealt with in a secular education system? Who should determine the content of high-school science classes? Should parents who don’t want their children to be taught about evolution, or some other scientific matter, be overruled by the state? These questions normally receive little public attention, but the clash between Darwinism and intelligent design has brought them to the fore.

科学是价值中立的吗？

Is science value-free?

人人都认同，科学知识有时会被用于不道德的目的——例如制造核武器和化学武器。但这些案例并不能证明科学知识本身在伦理上存在问题。真正不道德的是人们如何运用这些知识。事实上，许多哲学家认为，谈论科学或科学知识本身是否合乎伦理毫无意义。因为科学关注的是事实，而事实本身并不具有伦理意义。关键在于我们如何运用这些事实，这才是对错、道德与否的体现。从这个角度来看，科学本质上是一种价值中立的活动——它的作用仅仅是提供关于世界的信息。至于社会如何运用这些信息，则是另一回事。

Everybody would agree that scientific knowledge has sometimes been used for unethical ends—to make nuclear and chemical weapons, for example. But such cases do not show that there is something ethically objectionable about scientific knowledge itself. It is the use to which that knowledge is put that is unethical. Indeed many philosophers would say that it makes no sense to talk about science or scientific knowledge being ethical or unethical per se. For science is concerned with facts, and facts in themselves have no ethical significance. It is what we do with those facts that is right or wrong, moral or immoral. On this view, science is essentially a value-free activity—its job is just to provide information about the world. What society chooses to do with that information is another matter.

并非所有哲学家都接受这种将科学视为价值中立的观点，也不接受其所基于的事实/价值二分法。一些哲学家认为，科学探究总是带有价值判断的色彩。这种观点的一个论据源于一个显而易见的事实：科学家必须选择研究对象——不可能同时考察所有事物。因此，他们必须对不同研究对象的相对重要性做出判断，而这些判断在某种程度上也属于价值判断。另一个论据源于这样一个事实：任何一组数据原则上都可以用多种方式解释。因此，科学家对理论的选择永远无法完全由其数据决定。一些哲学家认为，这表明价值总是与理论选择息息相关，因此科学不可能做到价值中立。第三个论据是，科学知识无法像价值中立所要求的那样与其预期应用脱钩。在这种观点看来，将科学家想象成不带任何偏见、纯粹为了研究而研究，未加任何思考，未免过于天真。因为它具有实际应用价值。如今许多科学研究都由私营部门资助，这一事实也为这种观点提供了一定的佐证。

Not all philosophers accept this picture of science as neutral with respect to questions of value, nor the underlying fact/value dichotomy on which it rests. Some claim that scientific enquiry is invariably laden with value judgements. One argument for this stems from the obvious fact that scientists have to choose what to study—not everything can be examined at once. So judgements about the relative importance of different possible objects of study have to be made, and these are value judgements, in a weak sense. Another argument stems from the fact that any set of data can in principle be explained in more than one way. A scientist’s choice of theory will thus never be uniquely determined by their data. Some philosophers take this to show that values are invariably involved in theory choice, and thus that science cannot be value-free. A third argument is that scientific knowledge cannot be divorced from its intended applications in the way that value-freedom would require. On this view, it is naive to picture scientists as disinterestedly doing research for its own sake, without a thought for its practical applications. The fact that much scientific research today is funded by the private sector lends some credence to this view.

尽管这些论点很有趣，但它们都有些抽象——它们试图表明科学原则上不可能做到价值中立，而不是具体指出价值在科学中发挥作用的案例。不过，也确实有人提出了关于科学存在价值倾向的具体指控。本文将重点讨论两个例子，一个来自心理学/生物学，另一个来自医学。

Though interesting, these arguments are all somewhat abstract—they seek to show that science could not be value-free as a matter of principle, rather than identifying actual cases of values playing a role in science. But specific allegations of value-ladenness have also been made. Here we focus on two examples, one from psychology/biology and the other from medicine.

我们的第一个案例涉及进化心理学，这门学科试图运用达尔文的进化论原理来理解人类的心理构成及其行为。乍一看，这个项目似乎完全合理。因为人类也只是另一种动物，而生物学家们一致认为，达尔文的理论可以解释许多动物行为及其心理基础。例如，老鼠本能地害怕猫，这显然可以用达尔文的理论来解释。在过去，具有这种本能恐惧的老鼠往往比没有这种恐惧的老鼠留下更多的后代，因为后者更容易被捕食；假设这种本能是遗传的，并因此从父母传给后代，那么经过许多代，它就会在种群中传播开来。进化心理学家认为，人类心理的许多方面都可以用类似的达尔文理论来解释。

Our first case concerns the discipline of evolutionary psychology, which tries to understand the psychological make-up of humans, and their resulting behaviour, by applying Darwinian principles. At first blush this project sounds perfectly reasonable. For humans are just another species of animal, and biologists agree that Darwinian theory can explain a lot about animal behaviour and its psychological underpinnings. For example, there is an obvious Darwinian explanation for why mice have an instinctive fear of cats. In the past, mice with this instinctive fear tended to leave more offspring than ones without, as the latter got eaten; assuming that the instinct was genetically based, and thus transmitted from parents to offspring, over many generations it would have spread through the population. Evolutionary psychologists believe that many aspects of human psychology can be given a Darwinian explanation of this sort.

举例来说，以人类的择偶偏好为例。有证据表明，男性和女性在择偶标准上存在系统性差异。（这一证据的强度尚存争议。）大卫·巴斯进行的一项大型跨文化调查发现，男性平均而言更倾向于选择比自己年轻的女性伴侣，并且伴侣的年龄最好接近女性的生育高峰期（约24岁）。相比之下，女性则更倾向于嫁给比自己年长的男性。此外，外貌吸引力对男性而言更为重要，而女性则不然。对女性而言，收入潜力更为重要。巴斯和其他进化心理学家认为，这种偏好可以用达尔文主义来解释。从进化论的角度来看，男性最佳策略是寻找具有高繁殖潜力的女性伴侣，因为这能最大限度地增加其后代的数量。女性则更倾向于寻找地位高、能够掌控资源并有能力抚养后代的男性。（这种最佳交配策略的差异源于女性卵子数量有限，而男性精子数量几乎无限，因此对女性而言，抚养后代更为重要。）因此，有人认为，现代人类的择偶偏好可以用达尔文自然选择来解释。

To illustrate, consider human mating preferences. There is evidence that males and females systematically differ in the attributes they seek in their mating partners. (The strength of this evidence is a matter of debate.) A large cross-cultural survey by David Buss found that males on average preferred their female marriage partner to be younger than them, and to be of an age that coincides closely with peak female fertility (about 24 years). By contrast, females preferred to marry men who were older than them. Moreover, physical attractiveness mattered more to males, whereas earning potential mattered more to females. Buss and other evolutionary psychologists argue that these preferences have a Darwinian explanation. From an evolutionary viewpoint, the best strategy for a male is to find a female mate with high reproductive potential, as this maximizes the number of offspring he can have with her. Females should prefer to find a high-status male, who controls resources and is able to provide for the offspring. (This difference in optimal mating strategy stems from the fact that females have a limited supply of eggs, while males have effectively unlimited sperm, so offspring care matters more for females.) Therefore, it is argued, the mating preferences of modern humans can be explained by Darwinian natural selection.

尽管人类心理特征是由自然选择演化而来的观点看似合理，但进化心理学却是一个充满争议的领域，其从业者也一直被指责带有意识形态偏见。这场争议可以追溯到20世纪70年代和80年代的“社会生物学之争”。人类社会生物学是进化心理学的前身学科，两者都致力于寻求用达尔文主义的理论来解释人类行为。E.O.威尔逊（他于1975年出版的《社会生物学》一书奠定了该领域的基础）与他的哈佛同事理查德·莱文廷和斯蒂芬·杰伊·古尔德之间爆发了一系列激烈的争论。这场争论源于威尔逊的观点：许多人类社会行为，包括攻击性、强奸和仇外心理，都具有遗传基础，并且是自然选择所青睐的适应性特征，因为它们提高了我们祖先的繁殖成功率。

Though the idea that humans’ psychological traits have evolved by natural selection is plausible, evolutionary psychology is a controversial field, and its practitioners have been accused of ideological bias. The controversy dates back to the ‘sociobiology wars’ of the 1970s and 1980s. Human sociobiology was a precursor discipline of evolutionary psychology, and shared with it a commitment to seeking Darwinian explanations of human behaviour. A series of acrimonious exchanges took place between E. O. Wilson, whose 1975 book Sociobiology founded the field, and his Harvard colleagues Richard Lewontin and Stephen Jay Gould. The dispute arose from Wilson’s claim that many human social behaviours, including aggression, rape, and xenophobia, had a genetic basis, and were adaptations favoured by natural selection because they enhanced the reproductive success of our ancestors.

社会生物学招致了各种各样的批评，其中一些严格来说是科学性的。批评者指出，社会生物学的假设难以检验，因此应该被视为推测而非既定真理，并且不应低估文化对人类行为的影响。但另一些人的反对则更为根本，他们认为整个社会生物学体系在意识形态上都存在问题。他们认为这是一种试图为反社会行为（通常是男性）开脱，或为社会现象的必然性辩护的尝试。某些社会安排。例如，社会生物学家认为强奸具有遗传因素，是达尔文自然选择的结果，这似乎暗示强奸是“自然”的，因此强奸犯无需为自己的行为负责——他们只是在服从基因的驱使。简而言之，批评者指责社会生物学是一门价值判断的科学，而且它所承载的价值判断非常值得怀疑。

Sociobiology attracted a variety of criticisms, some of which were strictly scientific. Critics pointed out that sociobiological hypotheses were hard to test so should be regarded as conjectures not established truths, and that cultural influences on human behaviour should not be downplayed. But others objected more fundamentally, claiming that the whole sociobiological enterprise was ideologically suspect. They saw it as an attempt to excuse anti-social behaviour, usually by men, or to argue for the inevitability of certain social arrangements. By arguing that rape, for example, has a genetic component and has arisen by Darwinian selection, sociobiologists seemed to be implying that it was ‘natural’ and thus that rapists were not responsible for their actions—they were obeying their genetic impulses. In short, critics charged that sociobiology was a value-laden science, and the values it was laden with were very dubious.

在许多方面，现代进化心理学是对20世纪70年代和80年代社会生物学的改进。进化心理学的优秀研究拥有坚实的实证基础，并符合最严格的科学标准。早期社会生物学家天真的基因决定论已被更为细致入微的理论所取代，这种理论承认文化因素和基因都会影响行为，并且不忽视跨文化多样性。然而，进化心理学仍然招致批评，部分原因是它与社会生物学一样，强调人性的“阴暗面”，关注性、交配和婚姻等问题，以及男女之间所谓的先天心理差异。考虑到人类心理学涵盖的范围远不止于此，这些关注点多少有些令人惊讶。因此，进化心理学即便并非有意，也在强化现有刻板印象的指责很难完全避免。

In many ways, modern evolutionary psychology represents an improvement over the sociobiology of the 1970s and 1980s. The best work in evolutionary psychology has a strong empirical basis and meets the strictest scientific standards. The naive genetic determinism of the early sociobiologists has given way to a more nuanced picture in which cultural factors, as well as genes, are acknowledged to affect behaviour, and in which cross-cultural diversity is not ignored. However evolutionary psychology continues to attract critics, in part because it shares with its predecessor an emphasis on the ‘darker’ side of human nature, a focus on matters to do with sex, mating, and marriage, and on the supposed innate psychological differences between men and women. These foci are somewhat surprising, given that human psychology encompasses much more than this. Thus the charge that evolutionary psychology is serving to reinforce existing stereotypes, if only inadvertently, is hard to completely avoid.

对此指责的一种回应是坚持区分事实和价值。例如，一些进化心理学家提出，婚外情，或称“婚外性行为”，是一种进化而来的策略，当长期伴侣的基因质量较低时，女性会利用这种策略为后代获取基因优势。这种说法是否属实，想必是一个科学事实问题，尽管这个问题并不容易回答。但事实是一回事，价值又是另一回事。即使婚外性行为是一种进化适应，但这并不意味着它在道德上是正确的。因此，尽管进化心理学的研究重点相当具有选择性，但它本身并没有任何意识形态上的可疑之处。和所有科学一样，它只是试图告诉我们关于世界的事实。有时这些事实令人不安，但我们必须学会接受它们。

One possible response to this charge is to insist on the distinction between facts and values. Consider the suggestion made by some evolutionary psychologists that marital infidelity, or ‘extra-pair copulation’, is an evolved strategy that human females use to obtain genetic benefits for their offspring when their long-term mate is of low genetic quality. Whether this is true is presumably a question of scientific fact, though not an easy one to answer. But facts are one thing, values another. Even if extra-pair copulation is an evolutionary adaptation, that does not make it morally right. So there is nothing ideologically suspect about evolutionary psychology, despite its rather selective research foci. Like all sciences, it is simply trying to tell us the facts about the world. Sometimes the facts are disturbing, but we must learn to live with them.

第二个可能存在价值判断的例子来自精神病学，它是医学的一个分支，专门治疗抑郁症、精神分裂症和厌食症等精神疾病。精神病学家和哲学家之间一直存在着关于如何理解精神障碍（或精神疾病）概念的争论。一方信奉“医学模式”，认为某种疾病是否属于精神障碍完全是一个客观问题，不涉及任何价值判断。他们认为，精神疾病和生理疾病在这方面是相似的。例如，如果你患有糖尿病或肺气肿，那么你的身体机能就出现了问题；同样，如果你患有抑郁症或精神分裂症，那么你的精神状态就出现了问题。因此，在医学模式下，心理健康与疾病之间的界限与生理健康与疾病之间的界限一样客观。

Our second example of possible value-ladenness comes from psychiatry, the branch of medicine that treats mental disorders such as depression, schizophrenia, and anorexia. There is an ongoing debate among psychiatrists and philosophers over how the concept of mental disorder (or mental illness) should be understood. One camp embraces the ‘medical model’, which says that it is a fully objective matter whether something is a mental disorder or not; no value judgements are involved. Mental and physical disorders are alike in this respect, it is argued. If you suffer from diabetes or emphysema, for example, then your physical body is not working properly; similarly, if you suffer from depression or schizophrenia, then your mind is not working properly. So the boundary between mental health and illness is just as objective as the boundary between physical health and illness, on the medical model.

另一种观点认为精神障碍本质上是一个规范性范畴，其中包含隐含或显式的价值判断。在这种观点看来，如果某种行为模式偏离社会预期，或被他人视为“异常”，那么它就会被贴上精神障碍的标签。例如，直到不久前，同性恋在西方国家还被视为一种精神障碍；直到1973年，美国精神病学会才将同性恋从《精神疾病诊断与统计手册》（DSM ）中移除，而且并非所有会员都同意这一决定。此外，医学人类学家记录了不同文化背景下社会所认可的精神障碍存在显著差异，而DSM长期以来一直难以应对这一问题。因此，认为精神障碍是一个带有价值判断或规范性概念的观点无疑是合理的。这种观点的支持者通常认为，精神障碍根本不是一个真正的医学范畴，而是……与其说是社会控制的工具，不如说是精神疾病的一种手段。美国精神病学家托马斯·萨斯在其1961年出版的著名著作《精神疾病的神话》中提出了这种论点的激进版本。

An alternative view regards mental disorder as an inherently normative category, involving implicit or explicit value judgements. Something gets labelled a mental disorder, on this view, if it involves behaviour patterns that deviate from society’s expectations, or that others regard as ‘deviant’. For example, homosexuality was regarded as a mental disorder in Western countries until quite recently; it was only in 1973 that the American Psychiatric Association removed homosexuality from the DSM (Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders), and not all of its members agreed. Moreover, medical anthropologists have documented considerable cross-cultural variation in the mental disorders that a society recognizes, something that the DSM has long struggled to handle. So the view that mental disorder is a value-laden or normative concept is certainly plausible. Proponents of this view typically argue that mental disorder is not a genuine medical category at all, but rather an instrument of social control. A radical version of this argument was made by the American psychiatrist Thomas Szasz in a famous 1961 book entitled The Myth of Mental Illness.

“医学模式”与“精神障碍本质上带有价值判断”的观点之间的争论十分复杂。其中一个问题涉及心智与大脑的关系。支持医学模式的一点是，至少已知某些精神障碍具有神经或神经化学基础，也就是说，它们是大脑疾病，通常源于大脑回路的缺陷。这正日益成为主流精神病学的观点。既然大脑是身体的一部分，这表明精神疾病和生理疾病之间并不存在泾渭分明的界限。因此，如果人们普遍认为生理疾病是客观的而非带有价值判断的，那么精神疾病也必然如此吧？

The debate between the ‘medical model’ and the view of mental disorder as inherently value-laden is complex. One issue concerns the relation between mind and brain. A point in favour of the medical model is that at least some mental disorders are known to have a neural or neurochemical basis, i.e. they are brain disorders, often arising from faulty brain circuitry. This is increasingly the view of mainstream psychiatry. Since the brain is part of the physical body, this suggests that there is no sharp dichotomy between mental and physical disorders. So if the category of physical disorder is agreed to be objective rather than value-laden, surely the same must be true of mental disorder?

尽管这种论点很有说服力，但它并非最终定论，原因有二。首先，对于某些精神障碍，例如儿童疾病自闭症和注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD），它们是否属于单一的、统一的疾病，目前仍存在争议。这些疾病的特征是多种症状同时出现，且症状在不同儿童之间存在显著差异。（这就是为什么自闭症被称为“谱系障碍”。）此外，许多此类症状在“正常”儿童身上也或多或少存在，而这些儿童并不符合诊断标准。这表明，在精神障碍的界定中存在一定的约定俗成或任意性；因此，即使承认心理功能取决于大脑的神经连接和化学物质，也不能由此推断精神障碍必然像身体疾病一样具有客观性。

Though powerful, this argument is not conclusive for two reasons. First, for some mental disorders, such as the childhood illnesses autism and ADHD, there are ongoing disagreements over whether they are single, unified disorders at all. These disorders are characterized by clusters of symptoms which often but not always co-occur, with substantial variation from child to child. (This is why autism is called a ‘spectrum disorder’.) Moreover, many of these symptoms are found to some degree or other in ‘normal’ children, who do not meet the diagnostic threshold. This suggests that there is an element of conventionality or arbitrariness in what gets counted as a mental disorder; so even allowing that mental functioning depends on brain wiring and brain chemistry, it does not follow that mental disorder is necessarily as objective a category as that of physical disorder.

其次，并非所有人都认同生理疾病是一个客观范畴。一些哲学家认为，任何关于疾病或紊乱的讨论，无论是生理上的还是心理上的，都带有规范性和价值判断的色彩。如果某人患有生理疾病，这意味着他们的身体或身体的某个部分出现了功能障碍——无法正常运作。理应如此。但有人认为，这种“理应”带有规范性色彩。谁来决定人体“应该”如何运作？毕竟，人类生理机能存在显著差异。有些人视力完美，有些人视力稍差，还有些人视力远不如人。任何试图划定界限并断言人类眼睛“应该”如何运作的做法，无疑都包含价值判断。例如，在一个视力不那么重要的社会里，这条界限很可能就划在别处。因此，在这种观点看来，精神疾病和生理疾病都是带有价值判断色彩的范畴。

Secondly, not all parties agree that physical disorder is an objective category. Some philosophers argue that any talk of disorder or illness, whether physical or mental, is inherently normative and value-laden.
